title: China&\#x27;s State Council Executive Meeting Calls for Stronger Market-Stabilization Role by &\#x27;National Team&\#x27;
summary: At a State Council executive meeting on November 27 chaired by Premier Li Qiang, China&\#x27;s government called for greater use of the "national team" to stabilize the stock market and for optimizing Central Huijin&\#x27;s quasi-"stabilization fund" function, while guiding insurance, enterprise annuity, and social security funds into the market. The meeting also urged listed companies to increase dividends and buybacks and called for stronger full-chain market supervision, but the report gave no specific funding size, tool arrangements, or timetable.
